items.title_en: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64
items.title_zh: Java4Shell：处理 Base64 时 OpenJDK 中的远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: Calif disclosed Java4Shell, tracked as CVE-2026-114938, a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder. OpenJDK is described as the most popular Java runtime. The vulnerability has a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2 out of 10, rated Critical. Its severity could make affected OpenJDK deployments a high-priority patching target.
items.summary_zh: Calif 披露了 Java4Shell（编号 CVE-2026-114938），这是 OpenJDK Base64 解码器中的内存破坏漏洞。OpenJDK 被称为最流行的 Java 运行时。该漏洞在 CVSS 4.0 中获得 9.2 分（满分 10 分），评级为“严重”。这一评级意味着受影响的 OpenJDK 部署可能需要优先修补。

items.title_en: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine
items.title_zh: Quad9 退出法国：煤矿里的金丝雀
items.summary_en: Swiss nonprofit Quad9 said it will withdraw its free public DNS resolver from France after months of litigation. A French court imposed daily financial penalties because Quad9 did not block domains linked to alleged copyright infringement. Quad9 said the choice was between crippling penalties and changing its service in ways that would undermine user privacy and security. The case is presented as a warning about the consequences of mandating DNS-level blocking.
items.summary_zh: 瑞士非营利组织 Quad9 表示，将在经历数月诉讼后退出法国免费公共 DNS 解析服务。法国法院因其未屏蔽涉嫌侵犯版权的域名，对 Quad9 处以每日罚款。Quad9 表示，它只能在承受可能令组织陷入困境的处罚，或改变服务并损害用户隐私与安全之间作出选择。该事件被视为强制实施 DNS 层拦截可能带来后果的警示。

items.title_zh: Apple 服务中断

items.summary_zh: 据报道，Apple 服务发生中断。现有信息未说明受影响的具体服务、持续时间或原因。

items.title_en: ID.me terms required for IRS sign-in
items.title_zh: IRS 登录要求接受 ID.me 条款
items.summary_en: Taxpayers using ID.me to sign in to IRS online services accept terms that send most disputes to arbitration rather than a judge or jury, unless they opt out within 30 days. ID.me's privacy policy says it may use information for marketing and transfer information during a sale, merger, or similar transaction. It excludes government identity-verification data from ID.me Shop marketing unless the user consents or another listed exception applies. Login.gov and IRS Direct Pay remain alternatives for IRS access.
items.summary_zh: 纳税人使用 ID.me 登录美国国税局在线服务时，将接受把大多数争议提交仲裁、而非交由法官或陪审团审理的条款，除非在 30 天内选择退出。ID.me 的隐私政策称，其可能将信息用于营销，并在出售、合并或类似交易中转移信息。政府身份验证数据通常不会用于 ID.me Shop 的营销，但用户同意或符合其他列明例外的情况除外。IRS 仍提供 Login.gov 和无需登录的 Direct Pay 作为替代方式。

items.title_en: New Evidence Shows School Phone Bans Are Gradually Improving Test Scores
items.title_zh: 新证据显示，学校禁用手机正逐步提高考试成绩
items.summary_en: A large national analysis comparing students’ scores before and after cellphone bans found modest academic improvements. Schools with strict policies requiring students to lock phones in pouches for the entire school day saw math and reading gains equivalent to roughly one or two additional weeks of schooling per year. The study was published by Harvard’s Center for Education Policy Research and is the first national study to track individual students’ growth in this way.
items.summary_zh: 一项比较学生禁用手机前后成绩的大型全国性分析发现，学业表现出现小幅改善。要求学生在整个上课日将手机锁入袋中的学校，数学和阅读成绩提升幅度相当于每年额外增加约一至两周的学习。该研究由哈佛教育政策研究中心发布，是首项以这种方式追踪个体学生成长的全国性研究。

items.title_en: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%
items.title_zh: 谷歌 AI 答案让搜索流量下降 40%
items.summary_en: A randomized experiment found that Google AI Overviews reduce clicks to external websites by about 40% among US desktop users. The summaries now appear on more than half of the US keywords tracked by DataForSEO, up from 6% two years earlier. Generative engine optimization has not yet demonstrated a way to offset the lost traffic, while AI assistants sent websites only 0.3% of their traffic in March. The findings indicate that traditional search rankings bring substantially fewer visits when an AI answer appears above them.
items.summary_zh: 一项随机实验发现，在美国桌面用户中，谷歌 AI Overviews 会让外部网站获得的点击量减少约 40%。根据 DataForSEO 的跟踪数据，这些摘要如今出现在超过一半的美国关键词结果中，而两年前这一比例仅为 6%。生成式引擎优化尚未证明能弥补这部分流量损失；3 月份，AI 助手为网站带来的流量仅占 0.3%。这表明，当 AI 答案出现在搜索结果上方时，传统排名带来的访问量会显著下降。

items.title_zh: jQuery 4.1.0

items.title_en: 350 years ago, Ole Rømer discovered that light has a finite speed
items.title_zh: 350 年前，奥勒·罗默发现光速有限
items.summary_en: In September 1676, Ole Rømer predicted that Jupiter's moon Io would emerge from the planet's shadow 10 minutes later than expected. He presented the prediction to members of the Académie des Sciences in Paris. The observation demonstrated that light takes time to travel.
items.summary_zh: 1676 年 9 月，奥勒·罗默预测木星卫星木卫一从行星阴影中出现的时间会比预期晚 10 分钟。他将这一预测提交给巴黎科学院成员。这一观测证明了光的传播需要时间。

The forum lets customers ask questions, share advice, and troubleshoot Apple products and services. The project is maintained by volunteers and depends on donations to cover its infrastructure costs.

items.title_en: Phrack 73 Released
items.title_zh: Phrack 第 73 期发布

The previous anniversary issue included print editions, a capture-the-flag event with exploit challenges, puzzles, and conference events. The relaunch aimed to encourage readers to research, write, and contribute again. The new issue continues that effort to put security research in readers' hands.
items.summary_zh: Phrack 第 73 期已经发布，此前该刊曾以 40 周年重启为契机推出纪念活动。周年版本发行了纸质版，举办了包含漏洞利用挑战的 CTF，并在多个会议期间组织活动和演讲。重启的目标是重新鼓励读者开展研究、写作和投稿。新一期延续了将安全研究带给读者的方向。

items.title_en: Solid 2.0
items.title_zh: Solid 2.0
items.summary_en: Solid 2.0 has reached a stable release after five years of development. It adds asynchronous work in the reactive graph, server functions, agent-oriented diagnostics, and a smaller API. Solid's original fine-grained, signal-based approach has since become more common across frontend frameworks. The release builds on that model while simplifying the framework's interface.
items.summary_zh: Solid 2.0 在经过五年开发后达到稳定版本。它加入了响应式图中的异步能力、服务器函数、面向代理的诊断工具，并缩小了 API。Solid 最初采用的细粒度信号式方案如今已在多个前端框架中变得普遍。此次发布在延续这一模型的同时简化了框架接口。

items.title_en: We don't need more apps, we need better open source
items.title_zh: 我们不需要更多应用，而需要更好的开源软件
items.summary_en: AI has made it easy to build small applications over a weekend, such as habit trackers, to-do lists, and note-taking tools. The author argues that more of this energy should go toward improving the open-source software people already rely on, making it faster, lighter, and easier to run. The point is not to discourage people from building, but to redirect some of that effort toward shared infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能让人们可以在一个周末轻松构建习惯追踪器、待办事项和笔记应用等小型软件。作者认为，更多这类精力应投入到改进人们已经依赖的开源软件上，让它们更快、更轻量、更易运行。重点不是阻止人们开发新东西，而是将部分努力转向共享基础设施。

items.title_en: What is the best harness for each model?
items.title_zh: 每种模型最适合什么 harness？
items.summary_en: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 tested 22 coding-agent harnesses with five models across the same 62 tasks, repeating each test four times for 27,280 runs. The best-value harness varied by model, and cost rankings also shifted substantially between models. With the model held constant, the most expensive harness cost 1.8 to 5 times more per task than the cheapest. The results suggest that changing models may also require reconsidering the harness.
items.summary_zh: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 使用 5 个模型，在相同的 62 项任务上测试了 22 个编码代理 harness，每项测试重复 4 次，共运行 27,280 次。性价比最高的 harness 因模型而异，成本排名也会随模型大幅变化。在固定模型的情况下，最贵 harness 的单任务成本是最便宜者的 1.8 至 5 倍。结果表明，更换模型时可能也需要重新评估所用的 harness。

items.title_en: Web Browser Engineering (2021)
items.summary_en: Web Browser Engineering explains how browsers work by building a basic but complete browser in a few thousand lines of Python. It covers networking through JavaScript and focuses on making browser internals understandable. The book uses language-agnostic pseudocode and interactive demonstrations while concentrating on ray tracing and rasterization. It is intended for readers with basic programming knowledge and high-school mathematics.
items.summary_zh: 《浏览器工程》通过用几千行 Python 构建一个基本但完整的浏览器，解释浏览器的工作原理。内容覆盖从网络到 JavaScript 的多个部分，重点是让浏览器内部机制易于理解。本书使用与语言无关的伪代码和交互式演示，重点讲解光线追踪与光栅化。读者只需具备基础编程知识和高中数学水平。

items.title_en: Human.md
items.title_zh: Human.md
items.summary_en: Human.md is presented as a working manifesto about what humans contribute as machines become increasingly capable. It reflects on the difference between surface-level taste and the deeper judgment behind it. The text leaves open whether that human capability can ever be replicated by models.
items.summary_zh: Human.md 是一份关于机器日益强大之后人类仍能带来什么的工作中的宣言。它思考了表层的“品味”与其背后更深层判断力之间的差异。文章没有断言这种人类能力是否永远无法被模型复制。

items.title_en: Show HN: Alloy CSS, dialogs, menus and tabs that work with JavaScript off
items.title_zh: Show HN：Alloy CSS——关闭 JavaScript 也能工作的对话框、菜单和标签页
items.summary_en: Alloy CSS is demonstrated through a single page for a fictional invoicing application built without JavaScript. The page includes invoices for Okafor Legal and Tidewater Coffee totaling $2,200.00. It also represents recurring billing timing, with charges set for three days before the due date, on the due date, and every seven days afterward.
items.summary_zh: Alloy CSS 通过一个不使用 JavaScript 构建的虚构发票应用单页进行展示。页面包含 Okafor Legal 和 Tidewater Coffee 的发票，合计金额为 2200 美元。它还展示了周期性账单时间设置：到期日前三天、到期日当天，以及之后每隔七天。

items.title_en: Cerebras Disaggregated Inference
items.title_zh: Cerebras 的解耦推理
items.summary_en: Cerebras has deployed a disaggregated inference setup in which AMD GPUs handle prompt processing, or prefill, while wafer-scale Cerebras systems generate the output, or decode. The company says this combination delivers five times more tokens per megawatt without reducing token-generation speed. The design is intended to address growing demand for fast inference. It separates the two phases so each hardware type handles the workload it is designed for.
items.summary_zh: Cerebras 推出了一种解耦推理架构：AMD GPU 负责提示词处理（prefill），晶圆级 Cerebras 系统负责输出生成（decode）。公司称，在不降低 token 生成速度的情况下，这种组合每兆瓦可提供多 5 倍的 token。该设计旨在应对不断增长的高速推理需求。它将两个阶段分开，由各自适合的硬件承担相应工作。

items.title_en: Effects of a Nuclear Detonation in Low Earth Orbit
items.title_zh: 低地球轨道核爆炸的影响
items.summary_en: A study modeled the effects of a 1-megaton nuclear detonation at 500 kilometers over the South Atlantic. In its central case, trapped radioactive electrons would disable about 98% of modeled low-Earth-orbit satellites within one week, while roughly 97% would remain disabled after two weeks under a higher radiation-tolerance assumption. The loss of maneuverability could lead to about 20 collisions within two years, with debris and radiation continuing to affect replacement satellites. The model indicates that one detonation could severely damage orbital infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 一项研究模拟了在南大西洋上空 500 公里处引爆一枚 1 兆吨核武器的影响。在其中间情景下，被困在地球磁场中的放射性电子会在一周内使约 98% 的模拟低地球轨道卫星失效；即使提高卫星的辐射耐受度，两周后仍约有 97% 失效。卫星失去机动能力可能在两年内造成约 20 次碰撞，辐射和碎片还会持续影响替代卫星。模型显示，一次核爆炸就可能严重破坏轨道基础设施。

items.title_en: Windows 11 is collecting data on which coding agents and developer tools you use
items.title_zh: Windows 11 正收集你使用哪些编程代理和开发工具的数据
items.summary_en: Reverse engineering of Windows 11’s MissionControlAggregator found coding-agent and developer-tool usage bits in a diagnostic ETW report. The observed list includes Codex, Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Python, .NET, GCC, and Visual Studio Code executables. The finding raises questions about why a Windows system DLL records the use of these tools.
items.summary_zh: 对 Windows 11 的 MissionControlAggregator 进行逆向分析后，研究者在诊断 ETW 报告中发现了编程代理和开发工具的使用标记。相关列表包括 Codex、Claude、Copilot、Cursor，以及 Python、.NET、GCC 和 Visual Studio Code 等可执行文件。这一发现引出了一个问题：Windows 系统 DLL 为何要记录这些工具的使用情况。

items.title_en: Baidu, Xiaomi CEOs warn of growing gap between AI hype and returns
items.title_zh: 百度和小米 CEO 警告：AI 热潮与回报之间的差距正在扩大
items.summary_en: The CEOs of Baidu and Xiaomi warned that the gap between enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and the returns it produces is growing.
items.summary_zh: 百度和小米的首席执行官警告称，人工智能热潮与其带来的回报之间的差距正在扩大。

items.title_en: Not Everything Needs an LLM
items.title_zh: 并非一切都需要 LLM
items.summary_en: The discussion describes using small decision checks to bypass LLM calls in most cases. One example uses thresholds of 0.4 for PII detection and 0.85 for a Slack bot. Splitting one broad question into two narrower yes-or-no questions allowed 98.7% of summaries to skip the LLM call. The approach uses explicit trade-offs about the cost of different mistakes to reduce unnecessary model usage.
items.summary_zh: 讨论介绍了使用小型决策检查，在大多数情况下跳过 LLM 调用。一个例子为 PII 检测设置 0.4 阈值，为 Slack 机器人设置 0.85 阈值。将一个宽泛问题拆成两个更具体的判断题后，98.7% 的摘要可以跳过 LLM 调用。这种方法通过明确不同错误的代价，减少不必要的模型使用。

items.title_en: Purism Launches Librem 5 v2, a RISC-V Phone to Empower People
items.title_zh: Purism 推出 Librem 5 v2：一款旨在赋予用户自主权的 RISC-V 手机

The next-generation phone is powered by open-source software and is designed as an alternative to major technology companies' smartphone ecosystems. The announcement describes it as the successor to Purism's flagship smartphone. The campaign was announced in San Francisco on November 17, 2026.

items.title_en: Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review
items.title_zh: 哈佛研究人员：AI 编码代理将瓶颈转移到了代码审查
items.summary_en: A working paper covering 718 firms found that companies adopting AI coding agents produced about 30% more code. However, the amount of completed work did not measurably increase, and getting code through review took 49% longer. The study was written by Harvard Ph.D. candidates Fiona Chen and James Stratton and is not identified as peer-reviewed. Its measures suggest that reviewer time and approved work, not raw code output, are important when evaluating coding agents.
items.summary_zh: 一篇覆盖 718 家公司的工作论文发现，采用 AI 编码代理的企业产出的代码量增加了约 30%。但完成的工作量没有明显增长，代码通过审查所需的时间反而增加了 49%。论文作者是哈佛博士候选人 Fiona Chen 和 James Stratton，目前未显示已经过同行评审。研究结果表明，评估编码代理时应关注审查时间和最终获批的工作，而不仅是代码产量。

items.title_en: Optimizely compromised, served malware on Zoom, GitLab
items.title_zh: Optimizely 遭入侵，Zoom、GitLab 等网站被投放恶意软件
items.summary_en: On November 16, 2026, malicious JavaScript was served through Optimizely’s Web experimentation platform to visitors of 178 organizations, including Zoom, the BBC, CNN, Salesforce, GitLab, IKEA, HSBC, and others. The malware could replace cryptocurrency wallet addresses, skim payment-card data, steal cookies and screenshots, and deliver the Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits on iPhones and iPads. Cryptocurrency had already been stolen in transactions verified as belonging to the attackers.

items.title_zh: AT&T 在虚假广告诉讼中称，Comcast 的“光纤 Wi‑Fi”其实使用的是有线网络
items.summary_en: AT&T alleges that Comcast marketed cable internet as “fiber-powered Wi-Fi.” AT&T is seeking the profits Comcast made from that advertising.
items.summary_zh: AT&T 指控 Comcast 将有线互联网宣传为“光纤驱动的 Wi‑Fi”。AT&T 要求 Comcast 交出其通过相关广告获得的利润。

items.title_en: Show HN: TrnRT – An open-source LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium
items.title_zh: Show HN：TrnRT——面向 AWS Trainium 的开源 LLM 推理引擎
items.summary_en: RunAnywhere open-sourced TrnRT, an inference engine for AWS Trainium that currently serves GLM-5.3 Flash in FP8 on an AWS trn2.48xlarge instance. It can serve two model instances on one box using eight Trainium2 chips and a cache-aware router. On the SemiAnalysis AgentX benchmark, the team reports 3.57 million tokens per minute. The project targets large models with long context windows and aims to improve cost efficiency compared with H100 and H200 deployments.
items.summary_zh: RunAnywhere 开源了 TrnRT，这是一个面向 AWS Trainium 的推理引擎，目前可在 AWS trn2.48xlarge 实例上以 FP8 运行 GLM-5.3 Flash。它可借助 8 个 Trainium2 芯片和感知缓存的路由器，在一台机器上服务两个模型实例。团队称，其在 SemiAnalysis AgentX 基准上的性能达到每分钟 357 万个 token。该项目面向长上下文大模型，目标是相较 H100 和 H200 部署提升成本效率。

items.title_en: Nvidia Beats Estimates, Raises Guidance After Huang's Ouster
items.title_zh: 英伟达业绩超预期，在黄仁勋被罢免后上调指引
items.summary_en: Nvidia beat analysts' estimates and raised its guidance after Jensen Huang's ouster. No further figures or details about the results are established here.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋被罢免后，英伟达业绩超出预期并上调了指引。现有信息未提供具体业绩数据或更多细节。

items.title_en: Computer Graphics from Scratch
items.title_zh: 从零开始学计算机图形学
items.summary_en: Computer Graphics from Scratch introduces computer graphics through the algorithms behind animated films and video games. It focuses on ray tracing and rasterization, with interactive demonstrations throughout. The algorithms are developed without external libraries or APIs and presented in language-agnostic pseudocode. The material is aimed at readers with basic programming knowledge and high-school mathematics.
items.summary_zh: 《从零开始学计算机图形学》通过动画电影和电子游戏背后的算法介绍计算机图形学。内容重点讲解光线追踪和光栅化，并配有交互式演示。书中不依赖外部库或 API，而是使用与语言无关的伪代码推导算法。目标读者只需具备基础编程知识和高中数学水平。

items.title_en: Interpreting claims that a theorem is correct because it was checked in Lean
items.title_zh: 如何理解“定理已在 Lean 中检查，因此正确”的说法
items.summary_en: The post explains how to interpret claims that a theorem is correct because it was checked in Lean. It argues that Lean code provides an important signal, but AI-generated code should undergo additional tests before being trusted. The discussion notes that such tests have not yet been systematically applied to many items in OpenAI’s 722-paper theorem dump, about 45% of which included Lean code, while three non-Leanified papers were later retracted for a sign error.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章解释了应如何理解“定理已在 Lean 中检查，因此正确”这一说法。文章认为，Lean 代码确实提供了重要信号，但由 AI 生成的代码在获得信任前仍应接受额外测试。文中指出，在 OpenAI 收录 722 篇数学论文、约 45% 附带 Lean 代码的定理汇编中，这类测试尚未得到系统执行；其中三篇未 Lean 化的论文后来因符号错误被撤稿。

items.title_en: My Quest to push native Three.js quality match AAA Game Engines
items.title_zh: 我让 Three.js 原生画质追赶 AAA 游戏引擎的探索
items.summary_en: The project measures Three.js against an indoor-scene lighting pipeline used by games. The pipeline includes lightmaps, light probes, reflection probes, screen-space reflections, screen-space global illumination, and ambient occlusion. The analysis compares what games require, what Three.js currently provides, and which parts remain to be implemented.
items.summary_zh: 该项目将 Three.js 与游戏使用的室内场景光照管线进行对比。管线包括光照贴图、光照探针、反射探针、屏幕空间反射、屏幕空间全局光照和环境光遮蔽。分析比较了游戏所需能力、Three.js 当前已有的功能，以及仍待实现的部分。

items.title_en: Spamhaus new email sender requirements in November
items.title_zh: Spamhaus 11 月新的电子邮件发件人要求
items.summary_en: Spamhaus is gradually introducing a requirement that every sending IP have a valid HELO, a reverse-DNS PTR record, and a matching A record starting in November 2026. The guidance also covers infrastructure, authentication, list hygiene, reputation, and email service-provider requirements. Senders are expected to meet these minimum requirements to avoid being listed.
items.summary_zh: Spamhaus 将从 2026 年 11 月起逐步要求每个发件 IP 都具备有效的 HELO、反向 DNS PTR 记录以及匹配的 A 记录。其指南还涵盖基础设施、身份验证、邮件列表卫生、信誉和邮件服务商要求。发件方需要满足这些最低要求，以避免被列入黑名单。

items.title_en: How to Break into Security, Ptacek Edition (2012)
items.title_zh: 如何进入信息安全行业：Ptacek 版（2012）
items.summary_en: People regularly ask how to enter computer security, including career changers and IT professionals seeking to move into the field. The author asked leading security practitioners for their advice after finding his own standard answers incomplete. This is the first installment of a planned series collecting their differing perspectives.
items.summary_zh: 人们经常询问如何进入计算机安全领域，其中包括想转行的人和希望从 IT 转入安全行业的从业者。作者认为自己的固定回答不够全面，因此向多位安全领域专家征求建议。这是一个系列的第一篇，后续将汇集他们各不相同的观点。

items.title_en: A.I. Just Blew Up a Key Tenet of Computer Science
items.title_zh: 人工智能刚刚颠覆了计算机科学的一项关键定理
items.summary_en: A longstanding hypothesis held that some problems would always remain difficult for computers to solve quickly. The report says OpenAI disproved that hypothesis through a development in AI-generated mathematics, using the example of solving very large Sudoku puzzles to explain the result. If the result holds up, it could point to radically more efficient ways of solving certain computational problems.
items.summary_zh: 一项长期存在的假设认为，有些问题无论如何都不可能让计算机快速解决。报道称，OpenAI 通过 AI 生成数学领域的一项进展推翻了这一假设，并以解决超大型数独谜题为例解释其意义。如果这一结果经得起验证，它可能指向解决某些计算问题的全新高效方法。

items.title_en: Squircles
items.title_zh: 圆方形
items.summary_en: A squircle is a shape between a square and a circle, with no single mathematical definition. Different curves can represent squircles, and they can vary continuously between circular and square forms. The superellipse is the best-known example, popularized by Piet Hein.
items.summary_zh: “圆方形”是介于正方形和圆形之间的一类形状，并没有唯一的数学定义。不同曲线都可以构成圆方形，其形态能够在圆形与方形之间变化。最著名的例子是由 Piet Hein 推广的超椭圆。

items.title_en: Mem Is Shutting Down
items.title_zh: Mem 即将关闭
items.summary_en: Mem has decided to shut down on January 15, 2027. The announcement covers key dates, subscription handling, and how users can move their notes. The company thanked users for entrusting it with ideas, meeting notes, drafts, and other personal information.
items.summary_zh: Mem 决定于 2027 年 1 月 15 日关闭。公告说明了重要日期、订阅处理方式，以及用户如何迁移笔记。公司感谢用户将想法、会议记录、草稿和其他个人信息托付给它。

items.title_en: Do Repeat Yourself
items.title_zh: 重复自己也有道理
items.summary_en: The piece argues that repetition can be beneficial in software design. It uses two teams building similar banking features with different languages and front ends to illustrate how service-oriented architectures let teams work in their preferred ways. The examples include filtering and queries, charts, and CSV/PDF exports.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，在软件设计中重复有时是有益的。它以两个团队开发相似银行功能、但采用不同语言和前端技术为例，说明面向服务的架构如何让团队按照各自擅长的方式工作。示例功能包括筛选与查询、图表以及 CSV/PDF 导出。

items.title_en: VisualBasic.World: A gallery of Planet Source Code programs from 1997 to 2012
items.title_zh: VisualBasic.World：1997 至 2012 年 Planet Source Code 程序集锦
items.summary_en: VisualBasic.World is a visual archive of projects created in Visual Basic. It lets visitors explore archived programs through their original screenshots.
items.summary_zh: VisualBasic.World 是一个收录 Visual Basic 项目的视觉档案馆。访客可以通过原始截图浏览这些归档程序。

items.title_en: First Photos of the Poles of a Rod-Shaped Bacterium
items.title_zh: 杆状细菌两端的首批照片
items.summary_en: Scientists have captured detailed images of the poles at the ends of rod-shaped bacteria for the first time. The advance came not from a new camera or scanner, but from keeping the tiny microbes still and alive long enough to image them. The images reveal a part of bacterial structure that had not previously been seen directly.
items.summary_zh: 科学家首次拍摄到了杆状细菌两端极点的清晰图像。这项进展并非来自新型相机或扫描仪，而是因为研究人员成功让这些微小微生物保持静止并存活足够长时间，以便进行成像。这些图像直接展示了此前从未被观察到的细菌结构部分。

items.title_en: Nimony: A New Compiler for Nim
items.title_zh: Nimony：一个新的 Nim 编译器
items.summary_en: Nimony is a new compiler for Nim that is built daily from its master branch. Users can unpack it and put its bin directory on their PATH. Its n command can operate without requiring a separate C compiler.
items.summary_zh: Nimony 是一个新的 Nim 编译器，每天从 master 分支构建。用户解压后将其 bin 目录加入 PATH 即可使用。它的 n 命令无需额外安装 C 编译器即可运行。

items.title_en: Goose Typing – Python Morsels
items.title_zh: 鹅式类型检查
items.summary_en: The piece explains how Python's `isinstance` can be used alongside duck typing. Although `isinstance` checks an object's type, the discussion argues that it can still support duck-typed designs. The combination allows type checking without abandoning Python's focus on behavior.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了如何在 Python 中将 `isinstance` 与鸭子类型结合使用。虽然 `isinstance` 会检查对象类型，但文中认为它仍可服务于鸭子类型设计。这种组合能够进行类型检查，同时不必放弃 Python 对对象行为的重视。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Axonnic (YC F26) – Sleeves that track fingers and estimate force
items.title_zh: Show HN：Axonnic——追踪手指并估算力度的袖套
items.summary_en: Axonnic has developed a forearm sleeve that uses muscle activity to decode finger movements and estimate fingertip force while leaving the hands uncovered. The sleeve has 64 surface-EMG channels and synchronizes muscle signals with hand tracking to generate training data for dexterous robots. The founders argue that EMG captures effort and subtle muscle activity that video alone cannot observe.
items.summary_zh: Axonnic 开发了一款前臂袖套，通过读取肌肉活动来解码手指动作并估算指尖力度，同时保持双手裸露。袖套配备 64 个表面肌电通道，并将肌肉信号与手部追踪同步，用于生成灵巧机器人训练数据。创始人认为，肌电信号能够捕捉视频无法单独观察到的用力程度和细微肌肉活动。

items.title_en: Stop Filming in Log?
items.title_zh: 停止拍摄 Log 格式？
items.summary_en: The author argues that log-encoded video can create unnecessary challenges for colorists and is often used because of the mistaken belief that log automatically looks like film. Videographers frequently underexpose log footage while expecting to fix it in post-production, a problem that also affects camera RAW and HDR workflows. The piece traces log video’s rise to ARRI’s Alexa in 2010 and notes that camera RAW had been introduced by RED in 2007.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，Log 编码视频可能给调色师带来不必要的困难，人们使用它往往是因为误以为 Log 天然具有胶片质感。摄像师经常将 Log 素材曝光不足，却指望后期修复；相机 RAW 和 HDR 工作流也存在类似问题。文章指出，Log 视频在 ARRI 于 2010 年推出 Alexa 后开始普及，而 RED 则在 2007 年引入了相机 RAW。

items.title_en: Test/verification technique effectiveness with Astra
items.title_zh: 使用 Astra 测试/验证技术的有效性
items.summary_en: An earlier evaluation found that GPT-5.6 Sol often produced caricatures of requested techniques such as TDD, QuickCheck, and Lean 4. In that test, asking for no specific method produced many poor unit tests but still performed better than explicitly requiring most named techniques. The rerun with GPT-6 Astra showed two major differences, though the supplied excerpt does not specify what they were.
items.summary_zh: 此前的评测发现，GPT-5.6 Sol 经常把 TDD、QuickCheck 和 Lean 4 等指定技术执行成形式化的“模仿品”。在那次测试中，不指定具体方法虽然会产生许多糟糕的单元测试，但表现仍优于明确要求使用多数特定技术。使用 GPT-6 Astra 重跑评测后出现了两项重大差异，但所给内容未说明具体差异。

items.title_en: Elephant-Goldfish Model
items.title_zh: Elephant-Goldfish Model
items.summary_en: Elephant-Goldfish Model is an open-source plugin for AI assistants that helps users develop ideas with contextual background. A user can create a plan with an assistant that knows the conversation, then have reviewers who did not see that conversation assess what is missing or unclear. The design separates context-rich planning from fresh review.
items.summary_zh: Elephant-Goldfish Model 是一个面向 AI 助手的开源插件，帮助用户在保留背景信息的情况下构思想法。用户可以让了解完整对话的助手制定计划，再交由未看过该对话的审阅者检查遗漏或含糊之处。其设计将充分利用上下文的规划与独立审查分开。

items.title_en: Japan's Hometown Tax (2018)
items.title_zh: 日本故乡税（2018）
items.summary_en: The piece explains an innovative Japanese tax policy for readers who may not usually follow public policy. The author says they came to understand the policy better than expected after meeting people interested in the subject and aims to clarify how it works.
items.summary_zh: 文章向平时不太关注公共政策的读者介绍日本一项创新税收政策。作者表示，在结识对这一领域感兴趣的人后，自己意外地对该政策有了较深入的理解，并希望借此解释其运作方式。

items.title_en: Exploiting Replay Protected Monotonic Counters to Brute-Force Windows Hello PINs
items.title_zh: 利用受重放保护的单调计数器暴力破解 Windows Hello PIN
items.summary_en: Researchers analyzed Replay Protected Monotonic Counters used to protect Windows Hello PIN lockout state on modern x86 systems. They found that voltage glitching can expose the HMAC key in Winbond SPI flash, allowing arbitrary counter forgery, while an AMD NV controller does not verify counter increments. They also report that some AMD platforms without RPMC flash may lack NV rollback protection altogether. These flaws can undermine the anti-hammering protections that make short Windows Hello PINs practical.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员分析了现代 x86 系统中用于保护 Windows Hello PIN 锁定状态的受重放保护单调计数器。他们发现，对 Winbond SPI 闪存进行电压故障注入可能泄露 HMAC 密钥，从而伪造任意计数器；AMD 的 NV 控制器则不会验证计数器递增。研究人员还称，部分未配备 RPMC 闪存的 AMD 平台可能完全缺少 NV 回滚保护。这些缺陷可能破坏反暴力尝试机制，而该机制正是短 Windows Hello PIN 能够安全使用的基础。

items.title_en: Turbo Pascal Compiler Written in Turbo Pascal
items.title_zh: 用 Turbo Pascal 编写的 Turbo Pascal 编译器
items.summary_en: A Turbo Pascal compiler has been written in Turbo Pascal.
items.summary_zh: 有人使用 Turbo Pascal 编写了一个 Turbo Pascal 编译器。

items.title_en: Why did modems have speakers? (2019)
items.title_zh: 调制解调器为什么会配备扬声器？（2019）
items.summary_en: The piece asks why modems had speakers.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨调制解调器过去为何配备扬声器。

items.title_en: Formal Verification Is Not Verifiable
items.title_zh: 形式化验证并不可验证
items.summary_en: The author argues that AI has helped bring formal verification into the mainstream. Writing in December 2025, the author said that developments over the preceding year made that conclusion difficult to dispute.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，人工智能已经推动形式化验证走向主流。作者在 2025 年 12 月写道，过去一年发生的发展让这一判断很难再被否认。文章进一步探讨了标题所指向的局限。

items.title_en: The Fossils That Haunted Lovecraft
items.title_zh: 困扰洛夫克拉夫特的化石
items.summary_en: In 1923, expeditions led by Roy Chapman Andrews returned from Mongolia’s Gobi Desert with large quantities of fossils, including fossilized eggs from the Flaming Cliffs. Newspapers described the eggs as the first dinosaur eggs ever discovered, and the American Museum of Natural History took them for the eggs of a dinosaur. The discovery became part of the fossil history associated with H. P. Lovecraft’s era.
items.summary_zh: 1923 年，Roy Chapman Andrews 率领的考察队从蒙古戈壁沙漠带回了大量化石，其中包括来自火焰崖的蛋化石。报纸将这些蛋描述为人类发现的首批恐龙蛋，美国自然历史博物馆也将其认定为恐龙蛋。这一发现成为洛夫克拉夫特所处时代化石史的一部分。

items.title_en: Show HN: VennDB: append-only in-memory Rust DB for rows queried using bit flags
items.title_zh: Show HN：VennDB——用位标志查询行数据的追加式内存 Rust 数据库
items.summary_en: VennDB is an append-only, in-memory database written in Rust that queries rows through bit-flag columns. It targets mostly static datasets loaded at startup and queried frequently with simple filters, with an emphasis on speed and compactness. For its limited use cases, the project has few dependencies and is described as faster than a naive implementation or a heavier option such as SQLite.
items.summary_zh: VennDB 是一个用 Rust 编写的追加式内存数据库，通过位标志列查询行数据。它面向主要在启动时加载、之后频繁使用简单过滤条件查询的静态数据集，重点是速度和紧凑性。在适用范围有限的场景中，该项目依赖很少，并被描述为比朴素实现或 SQLite 等更重量级方案更快。

items.title_en: Show HN: Zigzag, a native Mac browser for people leaving Arc
items.title_zh: Show HN：Zigzag——为离开 Arc 的用户打造的原生 Mac 浏览器
items.summary_en: Zigzag is a free, open-source Mac browser written in Swift and based on WebKit, created by a high-school student from Shanghai. It aims to provide an Arc-like interface and can import spaces, pins, history, passwords, and cookies from Arc or other browsers. Despite using WebKit, it supports Chrome extensions, including 1Password, Bitwarden, and Tampermonkey. The browser requires no account and claims to have no telemetry or analytics.
items.summary_zh: Zigzag 是一款由上海高中生开发的免费开源 Mac 浏览器，使用 Swift 编写并基于 WebKit。它试图提供类似 Arc 的界面，并可从 Arc 或其他浏览器导入空间、固定项目、历史记录、密码和 Cookie。虽然基于 WebKit，它仍支持 Chrome 扩展，包括 1Password、Bitwarden 和 Tampermonkey。该浏览器无需账户，并声称不包含遥测或分析功能。

items.title_en: Zoltraak and the Dynamics of Military Innovation
items.title_zh: 《Zoltraak》与军事创新动力学
items.summary_en: The work examines military innovation through the fictional setting of Zoltraak from Frieren. It defines military innovation as a change in operational practice that produces a significant increase in military effectiveness. The supplied excerpt identifies César Alexandre da Silva Aprile as an independent researcher and does not provide the paper's detailed argument.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章借助《葬送的芙莉莲》中的 Zoltraak 这一虚构设定，考察军事创新。文中将军事创新定义为能够显著提升军事效能的作战实践变化。现有摘录显示作者是独立研究者 César Alexandre da Silva Aprile，但未提供论文的详细论证。

items.title_en: Rows vs. Columns: How different are they, really?
items.title_zh: 行与列：它们到底有多不一样？
items.summary_en: The piece explains how storing data in columns instead of rows can fundamentally change how a database system operates. It begins with a bike-sharing CSV in which each row represents one ride and all known details about that record. Row-oriented organization is familiar because it mirrors how people commonly think about objects such as spreadsheets, JSON records, and SQL table entries.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了将数据按列而不是按行存储，如何从根本上改变数据库系统的工作方式。文章从一份共享单车 CSV 文件开始，其中每一行代表一次骑行及其全部已知信息。按行组织数据之所以常见，是因为它符合人们理解电子表格、JSON 记录和 SQL 表条目的方式。

items.title_en: Mouse Party
items.title_zh: Mouse Party
items.summary_en: Mouse Party is a free way to watch videos with friends in real time through a web browser. It is designed to work without a web server. The service is presented as a secure, browser-based option for synchronized group viewing.
items.summary_zh: Mouse Party 是一个让用户通过浏览器与朋友实时一起观看视频的免费工具。它的设计无需 Web 服务器即可运行。该服务定位为一种安全的、基于浏览器的同步观看方式。

items.title_en: Too Many Stadiums with Roofs
items.title_zh: 带屋顶的体育场太多了
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern society is building too many football stadiums with roofs. It uses the new Washington Commanders stadium as an example: the venue is expected to open in 2030 and has a reported cost of $2.7 billion. The author says the stadium looks impressive in a video rendering while questioning the broader trend toward roofed stadiums.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，现代社会正在建造过多带屋顶的橄榄球体育场。作者以新的华盛顿指挥官队体育场为例：该场馆预计于 2030 年开放，造价据报为 27 亿美元。作者称视频渲染中的体育场看起来很出色，但同时质疑建造带屋顶体育场的整体趋势。

items.title_en: Fixing a WebKit bug to see if promises are made of train tracks
items.title_zh: 修复 WebKit bug，看看 promise 是否由铁轨组成
items.summary_en: The piece explains JavaScript promises while fixing a WebKit bug involving thenables. Until July, a test program never finished in Bun or Safari. According to the JavaScript specification, a throwing getter should make `await p` throw as well; Node.js does so, while Safari 26 and Bun 1.3.14 printed `before`, reported the error, and then hung. The example illustrates a behavioral difference between runtimes.
items.summary_zh: 文章在修复一个涉及 thenable 的 WebKit bug 的同时，解释了 JavaScript promise。直到 7 月，一个测试程序在 Bun 或 Safari 中始终无法结束。按照 JavaScript 规范，抛出异常的 getter 应该让 `await p` 同样抛出异常；Node.js 符合这一行为，而 Safari 26 和 Bun 1.3.14 会打印 `before`、报告错误，随后挂起。这个案例展示了不同运行时之间的行为差异。

items.title_en: New Species of Giant Fungus Discovered in China Grows Up to 20 Inches Tall
items.title_zh: 中国发现新巨型真菌，最高可长到 20 英寸
items.summary_en: Researchers from the Kunming Institute of Botany discovered a new fungus species in China's Yunnan Province and named it Dianjunus rex. The ascomycete forms unusually large fruiting bodies, reaching up to 20 inches in height and nearly five pounds in weight. Its name refers to the ancient Dian Kingdom and the Chinese pronunciation of fungus. The species is notable for producing the largest recorded masses of mushroom-like fruiting bodies.
items.summary_zh: 中国科学院昆明植物研究所的研究团队在云南省发现了一种新真菌，并将其命名为 Dianjunus rex。它属于子囊菌，能形成异常巨大的子实体，高度可达 20 英寸，重量接近 5 磅。其名称取自古滇国以及“真菌”一词的中文读音。该物种因产生目前记录中最大的蘑菇状子实体而引人注目。

items.title_en: Fun with Constrained Programming
items.title_zh: 受限编程趣谈
items.summary_en: RAR files can contain bytecode for a simple x86-like virtual machine called RarVM. Because filters are executed automatically during unrar, the author examines whether code could escape the VM's sandbox. The discussion also considers what calls besides `write` might be available.
items.summary_zh: RAR 文件可以包含一种名为 RarVM 的简单类 x86 虚拟机字节码。由于解压过程中会自动执行过滤器，作者探讨了代码是否可能逃出该虚拟机的沙箱。文中还考察了除 `write` 之外可能可用的调用。

items.title_en: Munich Laser Emits a Beam of Matter Waves (1999)
items.title_zh: 慕尼黑激光器发射物质波束（1999）
items.summary_en: Scientists in Germany developed a laser that emits a continuous beam of matter waves rather than light. The work involved researchers from the Max Planck Institute for Quantum Optics and the University of Munich. It relies on controlling atoms at temperatures close to absolute zero, where their wave nature becomes observable. The result enables unprecedented control over atomic motion.
items.summary_zh: 德国科学家开发出一种发射连续物质波束、而非光束的激光器。研究人员来自马克斯·普朗克量子光学研究所和慕尼黑大学。该技术依赖于在接近绝对零度的温度下控制原子，此时原子的波动性会显现出来。研究成果实现了对原子运动前所未有的控制。
